text.title: Error Handling (RFC 7807 Problem Details) Output Contract
text.summary: Two contracts: the spec artefact this methodology emits, and the ProblemDetails response envelope that artefact commits the service to. Subagent MUST satisfy both before returning to caller.

required.field: the actual answer / chosen option / value produced
at least 2 sentences; cites at least one input artefact by name
list of input names with source paths or URLs

forbidden.pattern: rationale that does not reference any input by name
inputs_used empty AND decision is not 'no-op'
duplicate artefact_id within the same store

allowed-transformations.transformation: Trim rationale to no more than 500 chars, preserving numeric claims and named tools.
Promote 'no decision yet' to status='pending' rather than fabricating a decision.
Group near-duplicate inputs, recording the group with member count.

list.item: Every required field populated with a typed value
No forbidden pattern matches the output

section.title: Response envelope schema (what the service must emit)
section.reference: JSON Schema 2020-12 source — load it instead of duplicating; the block below is the same schema in JSON for reading.

example.note: Content-type is +json. status=400 matches the HTTP code. traceId comes from W3C traceparent. errors[] only on 4xx validation.

example.code:
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "psycopg2.OperationalError: connection refused at /opt/app/db.py:42", "stack": "Traceback (most recent call last)...", "code": 502 }
example.note: Five violations: wrong content-type (r-content-type-problem-json), missing type/title/status (r-envelope-required-fields), raw exception text (r-5xx-detail-is-static), stack trace (r-never-leak-stack), body code disagrees with the HTTP line (r-status-matches-class).

list.item: Every error response carries Content-Type: application/problem+json.
type / title / status are always present; status equals the HTTP status code.
For 5xx, detail is a static string — no exception text, no stack, no SQL, no internal path.
traceId is set on every response, sourced from traceparent or a generated UUID.
errors[] appears only on 4xx validation responses, each item carrying field / code / message.
type URIs are stable; any change is documented in CHANGELOG as breaking.
